descriptionChirho: A mournful cry or lamentation, expressing grief or sorrow, often in the context of prophetic judgment or funeral dirges. Both clusters convey the same meaning with S116577 being a single occurrence variant. Multilingual evidence converges: eng 'lamentation/wailing', spa 'lamento/endecha' (both mean dirge/lament), hin 'विलाप/रोना' (lamentation/weeping), arb 'نَحِيبًا/الرَّثاءِ' (wailing/elegy), kor '통곡/탄식' (wailing/sighing), swa 'maombolezo/kuomboleza'.
